messages:
jess: quick follow-up from the PM: three outstanding remediation items need owners + JIRA links. can we lock these before EOD?

rory: list them pls?

jess: A) persistent GC pause during mixed-batch writes B) alert dedup + threshold tuning (too many false pages) C) PM doc + customer-facing timeline + mitigation notes.

emma: I can take B (alert work). will open ticket and baseline alert noise.

pradeep: I'll take A (GC pause). need to coordinate with runtime team for heap snapshots.

lina: I can own C (doc + customer notes). will sync with solutions eng for wording.

jess: proposed RACI: A: R=pradeep, A=jess, C=runtime/eng-sre, I=customers; B: R=emma, A=rory, C=observability, I=jess; C: R=lina, A=ps-lead, C=solutions, I=legal.

emma: filing INF-4033 for alert dedup (baseline + PR). ETA initial PR 2026-04-04.

infra-bot: Created INF-4033 (Alert dedup & thresholds) and assigned to emma.

pradeep: opening INF-4034 for GC pause investigation. will attach heap dumps and trace timeline. ETA spike + recommendation 2026-04-05.

infra-bot: Created INF-4034 (GC pause: mixed-batch writes) and assigned to pradeep.

lina: creating INF-4035 for PM doc + customer notes, will include step-by-step mitigation and single-line rollback instructions. ETA 2026-04-02.

infra-bot: Created INF-4035 (Postmortem doc + customer timeline) and assigned to lina.

jess: backups? who covers if primary is oncall/OOO during execution?

emma: backup for B = rory.

pradeep: backup for A = emma.

lina: backup for C = jess.

jess: note recurrence: similar GC pause pattern popped up 5 times in last 12 weeks across private clusters under stress tests. tag tickets with "recurrence" and add brief timeline/snippets.

pradeep: will attach heap timelines and load profile to INF-4034.

emma: will attach alert history + false-positive examples to INF-4033.

lina: will include customer-facing summary and link to PM doc in INF-4035.

jess: admin: set the JIRA "remediation ETA" field, link PRs to PM doc, and add to the remediation board. i'll run a quick 10-min sync Wed 10:00 to confirm progress.

emma: INF-4033 ETA 2026-04-04. PR link posted.

pradeep: INF-4034 ETA 2026-04-05. adding dump links.

lina: INF-4035 ETA 2026-04-02. doc draft uploaded.

jess: thanks all. i'll leave this thread open until tickets are in progress and PRs linked. ping me if blockers show up and i'll escalate to platform leads. :white_check_mark:
